0022600181.text: The Rockets (7-1, 4-0 at home) host the Timberwolves (5-3) in the Rockets' ninth game of the season. Houston is first in the Southwest and the West and is riding a two-game win streak, while Minnesota is third in the Northwest, one game back, and in 8th in the West on a one-game win streak. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), with Terrence Shannon Jr. day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Rockets lost the season series 1-2, including a 136-132 loss in Houston on April 10, 2026.
